ann.current_none: The project has no annotations yet.
ann.backups_help: Made before a change that removes or rewrites annotations. Restoring brings that copy back; the current annotations are copied first, so it can be undone.
ann.backup_restore_text: The annotations become the ones of the copy from {when}. The current ones are copied first, so you can undo this.
ann.backup_restored: Annotations restored from the copy of {when}.
problem.invalid_file: A file could not be read or is not valid.
problem.excluded_image_entries: Some annotations are for excluded images and were not imported; those images keep their labels.
problem.unmatched_entries: Some annotations refer to images that are not in the project.
problem.ambiguous_image_name: Several images have this name, so the annotations were skipped.
problem.duplicate_image_entry: The same image appears more than once; later entries were skipped.
problem.size_mismatch: The image size in the file differs from the uploaded image.
problem.box_clipped: Some boxes went outside the image and were clipped.
problem.geometry_clipped: Some polygon points or keypoints went outside the image and were moved to its border.
problem.box_degenerate: Some boxes have no area and were skipped.
problem.polygon_too_few_points: Some polygons have fewer than 3 points and were skipped.
problem.no_geometry: Some labels do not have the shape this project type needs (box, polygon or keypoints); they are left out.
problem.no_images_matched: No annotation matches an image of this project. The image name must be the same as the file uploaded to the project (in class folders, the name of the file inside the folder).
problem.keypoints_count_mismatch: Some labels have a different number of keypoints from the others; they are left out.
problem.converted_to_box: Polygons or keypoints were converted to boxes.
problem.dropped_other_kind: Some annotations do not fit the task type and were left out.
problem.images_missing: Identical or unreadable images were not added.
problem.images_rejected: Some files are not readable images and were skipped.
problem.image_download_failed: Some images could not be downloaded.
problem.yolo_pose_ambiguous: Some YOLO lines could be a polygon or a pose; add a data.yaml with kpt_shape to settle it.
problem.unknown_class_id: Some annotations use a class that is not defined and were skipped.
problem.missing_class_names: Class names were not found; names like class_0 are used.
problem.keypoint_count_mismatch: Some objects have a different number of keypoints than expected.
problem.unsupported_annotation: Some annotations have no box, polygon or keypoints and were skipped.
problem.unsupported_shape: Some shapes of an unsupported type were skipped.
problem.rle_bbox_only: Mask (RLE) objects were imported as boxes only.
problem.invalid_annotation: Some annotations are malformed and were skipped.
problem.frames_not_in_task: Some annotations are on frames that the task does not use.
problem.frame_number_missing: Some entries have no frame number and were skipped.
cur.intro: Measures brightness, contrast, sharpness and near duplicates, and flags the images that may hurt your dataset. Nothing is removed unless you choose.
cur.not_analyzed: The images have not been analyzed yet.
cur.started: Analysis started. Follow it in the activities bar.
cur.all.help: Every active image of the project.
issue.blurry.help: Out of focus or motion blur; few sharp edges.
issue.dark.help: Very low brightness; details are hard to see.
issue.low_contrast.help: Flat image; little difference between light and dark areas.
issue.small.help: The shortest side is below the minimum size.
issue.odd_aspect.help: Much longer than tall (or the reverse), such as a panorama or a strip.
issue.grayscale.help: Black and white image in a project of color images.
issue.near_duplicate.help: Looks almost the same as another image; only one is kept unflagged.
cur.suggested_needs_analysis: Analyze the images to use the suggestions.
cur.suggested_none: No suggestions: nothing looks clearly worth excluding.
cur.excluded_n_one: {n} image excluded. You can restore it in the Excluded tab.
cur.excluded_n_other: {n} images excluded. You can restore them in the Excluded tab.
cur.delete_text_one: {n} image and its file will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
cur.delete_text_other: {n} images and their files will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
cur.thresholds_help: Changing a limit flags the images again without measuring them again.
cur.only_issues.help: Shows only the images with an issue flagged.
cur.hist_legend: Each bar is a range of values; its height is the number of images in it.
threshold.blur_relative: Blurry: sharpness below this fraction of the project's usual sharpness (0.5 = half)
threshold.blur_ceiling: Blurry: only if sharpness is below
threshold.max_aspect: Odd aspect: long side / short side above
threshold.phash_distance: Near duplicate: largest difference between two images (0 = identical)
cur.fo_hint: In FiftyOne, tag images with exclude, then click here.
cur.fo_starting: Preparing FiftyOne. It opens in a new tab when ready.
cur.fo_popup: FiftyOne is ready. Click "Open" in the activities bar (the browser blocked the new tab).
jobs.title: Activities
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.text: This project or page does not exist. It may have been deleted.
project.gone_text: It was deleted, maybe in another tab or window.
summary.images_kept: Images that kept their previous annotations
summary.classes_added: New classes added to the project
jobs.result_analyze: {measured} images measured; issue flags: {flagged} (an image can have more than one).
new.description_ph: e.g. Find cracks and porosity in weld images from line 3; images from the 2026 inspections.
cur.reset_text: Measures, issue flags and near-duplicate groups are cleared. Images, exclusions, annotations and thresholds are kept. You can analyze again afterwards.
taskchange.title: What should happen to the annotations?
taskchange.text: This project has {from} annotations ({images} images, {labels} annotations). They do not fit {to}. Choose what to do with them before the type changes.
taskchange.convert_help.detection: Each object becomes its bounding box.
taskchange.convert_help.classification: Each image gets the most frequent class among its objects.
taskchange.convert_help.segmentation: The annotations are converted to the new type.
taskchange.convert_help.keypoints: The annotations are converted to the new type.
taskchange.discard_help: A safety copy is kept and can be restored in the Annotations step.
jobs.result_analyze_none: No new images to measure; issue flags: {flagged}.
classes.in_use_text: These classes are used by annotations: {list}. Removing them also removes those annotations (a safety copy is kept and can be restored in the Annotations step).
problem.multiple_classes: Images with more than one class (only the first one is kept)
problem.unknown_class: Labels with classes that are not in the project (added to the project on apply).
problem.missing_images: Images the tool did not return (they are left unchanged).
problem.edited_on_both_sides: Images edited in FiftyOne whose project labels also changed since they were sent: applying replaces the project's version with FiftyOne's.
problem.box_invalid: Boxes without area or outside the image (they are skipped on apply).
problem.open_polyline: Open lines of fewer than 3 points are not polygons (they are skipped on apply).
problem.mask_only: Detections with a mask: only their box is kept.
annotate.nothing_to_send: There are no images to send with this choice.
annotate.sessions_empty: A session is a batch of images you sent to a tool. It stays here until you bring the annotations back, review them and apply them.
annotate.pull_hint: Finish your work in the tool, then bring the annotations back.
annotate.apply_none: No change came back, so there is nothing to apply.
annotate.discarded: Changes discarded. The project was not changed.
annotate.close_text: The session is removed from this list. The project annotations are not changed.
audit.title: Tasks on the CVAT server
audit.intro: A read-only list of what the server holds, by project. Nothing is changed or deleted here.
audit.loose_help: ActiveLabel only creates tasks inside a project. These came from other tools or older versions; they are grouped by name (digits shown as #).
audit.no_loose: There are no tasks outside a project.
annotate.diff_unknown_help: These classes are not in the project yet. They will be added when you apply.
annotate.setup_help.cvat: Use CVAT online or the address of your own server.
annotate.url_required: Enter the address of the tool.
annotate.secret_help: It is stored only in the system keychain of this computer.
annotate.secret_saved: One is already saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
annotate.forget_text: The address, the username and the saved password or token are removed from this computer.
import.title: Import a project
import.intro: Bring a project that already exists in CVAT. Its images and annotations are copied into a new ActiveLabel project, and nothing changes at the source.
import.tool.cvat.help: A project or a task from CVAT online or your own server.
import.not_configured: {tool} is not set up yet. Add its address and login to list its projects.
import.select_hint: Select a project in the list to continue.
import.summary: Images and annotations are downloaded and a new project is created. The type is detected from the annotations. Nothing changes in {tool}.
import.task_help: No annotations were announced for this project, so choose the type to use if it turns out to have none.
import.progress_help: You can leave this page open; it updates by itself.
import.cancelled: Import cancelled. No project was created.
annotate.legacy_note: This session belongs to a tool that has no edit sessions here any more. It can only be closed; nothing is changed in that tool.
sync.unlink_text_removed: The project in the other tool is not changed.
sync.link_unsupported: This link is to a tool that is no longer supported, so it cannot be synchronised. You can unlink it; nothing is changed in that tool.
sync.unlink_text: The project in {tool} is not changed.
sync.plan_ready: Comparison ready. Review it in the Annotations step.
sync.only_help: These images exist only in {tool}. They are left alone.
sync.conflicts_help: These images changed on both sides. Choose which version to keep for each one.
sync.stale: The remote project changed — synchronise again
sync.no_tasks: This project has no tasks yet.
sync.creates: The project is created in {tool} if it does not exist yet.

tasks.none: No tasks yet. Drop images here or create the first one.
tasks.incomplete: Upload cut off: images may be missing
tasks.incomplete_help: The upload of this task stopped midway (the page was closed or the connection dropped). The images that arrived were kept; send the missing ones in a new task.
tasks.job_excluded_one: {n} image of this job is excluded (the range counts all)
tasks.job_excluded_other: {n} images of this job are excluded (the range counts all)
tasks.name: Name (optional)
tasks.job_size_hint: Empty: a single job. Cannot change after creation.
tasks.job_size_invalid: Images per job must be a positive whole number, or empty.
tasks.see_images_job: See the images of job {n} of {name}
tasks.delete_text_one: The task and its {n} image will be deleted, with the files and annotations. This cannot be undone.
tasks.delete_text_other: The task and its {n} images will be deleted, with the files and annotations. This cannot be undone.
tasks.filter_empty: No images in this task or job.
tasks.refresh_help: Read the job states from CVAT again
tasks.refreshed: Job states read again from CVAT.

tasks.fo_no_keypoints: FiftyOne does not edit keypoints: use CVAT

tasks.cvat_not_linked: This project is not linked to CVAT: link it in the CVAT tab

sync.dir_both_help: Each change goes the way it was made. If both sides changed the same image, you choose.
sync.dir_pull_help: {tool} wins: this project becomes like it. What exists only here stays as it is.
sync.dir_push_help: This project wins: {tool} becomes like it. What exists only in {tool} stays as it is.
sync.only_here: Only here, left as it is
sync.only_here_help: These exist only in this project and are not sent to {tool}.
ds.intro: Freeze a split of your images and labels: train, validation and test.
ds.empty: No versions yet. Create the first one to freeze a split.
ds.incomplete_help: Some images of this version were deleted from the project.
ds.w_labels_without_geometry_one: {n} label does not have the shape this project type uses and is left out.
ds.w_labels_without_geometry_other: {n} labels do not have the shape this project type uses and are left out.
ds.w_multiple_classes_one: {n} image has more than one class: classification uses only the first.
ds.w_multiple_classes_other: {n} images have more than one class: classification uses only the first.
ds.w_keypoints_count_mismatch_one: {n} label does not have {expected} keypoints like the others and is left out.
ds.w_keypoints_count_mismatch_other: {n} labels do not have {expected} keypoints like the others and are left out.
ds.b_keypoints_count_mismatch_one: {n} label with another number of points
ds.b_keypoints_count_mismatch_other: {n} labels with another number of points
ds.w_group_drift_duplicates: Near-identical images stay together: the real split is {real}.
ds.stale_one: Labels changed after this version ({n} image) — create a new version to train with them
ds.stale_other: Labels changed after this version ({n} images) — create a new version to train with them
ds.stale_train_one: The labels of {n} image changed after v{version}: training uses the old labels. Create a new version to use the current ones.
ds.stale_train_other: The labels of {n} images changed after v{version}: training uses the old labels. Create a new version to use the current ones.
ds.w_avoidable_one: Only {n} image has it, but it could be in every part: try another seed or other proportions.
ds.w_avoidable_other: {n} images have it, enough for every part: another seed or other proportions may fix it.
ds.w_unavoidable_one: Only {n} image has it: it cannot be in every part.
ds.w_unavoidable_other: Only {n} images have it: it cannot be in every part.
ds.w_avoidable_all: Each has enough images for every part: another seed or other proportions may fix it.
ds.w_unavoidable_all: Each has too few images to be in every part.
ds.w_unavoidable_some_one: {n} of {total} has too few images to be in every part; the others could.
ds.w_unavoidable_some_other: {n} of {total} have too few images to be in every part; the others could.
ds.class_share: {pct}% of this class is in this part
ds.gap_switch: Drop frames at the border between parts of the same video (recommended)
ds.gap_off_warn: Without dropping, validation and test can contain frames almost identical to training ones: the metrics will be optimistic.
ds.delete_text: The version is removed for good. Your images and annotations are not touched.
ds.background_help: Images with no objects, used as negatives.
ds.seed_help: The same options and seed always give the same split.
ds.err_pct_range: {part}: enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
ds.err_sum_is: Training, validation and test add up to {n}%: they must add up to 100%.
ds.err_test_range: Test must be a whole number from 0 to 90%.
ds.w_group_drift_generic: The real split is {real}, different from what you asked.
ds.err_seed: The seed must be a whole number.
ds.w_group_drift: Whole videos stay together: the real split is {real}.
ds.w_duplicates: Near duplicates were not checked because curation was not run.
ds.videos_auto: Cut into distant segments when needed
ds.videos_help: A video stays in one part, unless that makes the proportions impossible: then it is cut into segments spread over its timeline, which adds variety between the frames.
ds.gap_help: Minimum time: the gap grows by itself to the frame interval and to the reach of the video's near-duplicates.
ds.err_gap: The minimum safety gap must be more than 0 seconds (turn the switch off to keep every frame).
ds.w_video_split: Video {name} was cut into {n} segments: {parts} use segments spread over time; {gap} frames were left out as a safety gap.
ds.w_video_split_nogap: Video {name} was cut into {n} segments: {parts} use segments spread over time.
ds.w_video_parts_shared: Scores may be optimistic: parts of the same video are in training and in validation/test. To measure new videos, keep videos whole.
gate.need_dataset: Split the data first: create a version in Data split.
tr.intro: Train a model on a dataset version. Every run is saved and can be repeated.
tr.empty: No runs yet. Start the first one.
tr.cancel_text: Training stops and its progress is discarded.
tr.config_error: The configuration of this run is missing or damaged, so it cannot be repeated.
tr.delete_text: Its metrics and weights are removed. This cannot be undone.
tr.no_options: There is no split version or model available.
tr.packages_note: This computer needs: {list}. If missing, they are installed the first time (needs internet and disk space).
tr.start_transfer_help: Pretrained weights; only the last layer learns. Fast, good with few images.
tr.start_finetune_help: Pretrained weights; every layer learns. Slower, often more accurate.
tr.start_scratch_help: Random weights; needs many images and epochs.
tr.mode_single_help: One run with the values below.
tr.mode_grid_help: Several values separated by commas: every combination is a run.
tr.grid_need: Give two or more values to at least one parameter.
tr.select_metric_help: Chooses the best epoch (and the best run).
tr.chg_none: Switching to {model}: same hyperparameters and defaults.
tr.chg_reset: {p} back to {v} ({old} does not suit this model)
tr.device_help: Where this run trains; automatic takes the GPU when there is one.
tr.warn.batch_halved: The GPU ran out of memory with a batch of {from} images: training goes on with {to}.
tr.warn.amp_needs_cuda: Mixed precision needs a CUDA GPU: this training runs in full precision.
tr.yaml_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it.
tr.confusion_help: Rows are the real class, columns the predicted one.
tr.ph.batch_size: Images per step (small suits a CPU).
tr.ph.lr: Size of each weight update step.
tr.ph.weight_decay: Penalises large weights to limit overfitting (regularisation).
tr.ph.scheduler: How the learning rate changes: none, cosine, steps, one-cycle (up, then down) or plateau (lower when the metric stops improving).
tr.ph.image_size: Side of the square input, in pixels.
tr.ph.augmentation: How much the training images are varied: a preset level or Custom (you choose the techniques).
tr.ph.patience: Stop after this many epochs without improvement (0 = off).
tr.ph.seed: Random seed (same seed, same data order).
tr.ph.backbone_lr_factor: Fine-tuning: the backbone learns at the learning rate times this factor.
tr.ph.trainable_backbone_layers: Backbone stages that train in fine-tuning.
tr.ph.score_thresh: Lowest score a prediction needs to be kept.
tr.ph.mosaic: Combines four images into one while training.
tr.ph.close_mosaic: Turn mosaic off for the last N epochs.
tr.ph.warmup_epochs: Epochs over which the learning rate rises from almost 0 (0 = off); steadies fine-tuning.
tr.ph.resize: How a photo becomes the square input: stretch (proportions change), letterbox (bands fill the rest) or centre crop (edges are cut). Evaluation, pre-annotation and export use the same rule.
tr.ph.amp: Mixed precision (float16) on a CUDA GPU: faster and lighter. Automatic and On use it on CUDA only; the CPU and Apple GPUs train in full precision.
tr.aug_help: Applied to the training images only, in this order. Ticking, unticking or changing a setting makes the level Custom.
tr.aug_none: No technique: the training images go in as they are. Tick one to vary them.
tr.aug_pairs_help: Points that swap places in a mirror image, such as 0-1, 2-3 (counted from 0). Empty: no point swaps.
tr.aug_custom_alone: Custom cannot be compared with other levels in the grid: choose it alone or only presets.
tr.augh.random_resized_crop: Crops a random part of the image and resizes it to the input size.
tr.augh.hflip: Mirrors the image left to right.
tr.augh.vflip: Mirrors the image top to bottom (aerial, microscope and document images).
tr.augh.rotation: Rotates the image by a random angle; the corners become black.
tr.augh.scale_jitter: Zooms in or out by a random factor.
tr.augh.translate: Shifts the image by a random offset.
tr.augh.randaugment: Applies random photo operations (contrast, sharpness, posterise…).
tr.augh.trivialaugment: One random photo operation of random strength; no settings.
tr.augh.color_jitter: Changes brightness, contrast, saturation and hue at random.
tr.augh.grayscale: Turns the image grey: the model relies less on colour.
tr.augh.random_erasing: Erases a random rectangle: the model looks at more of the object.
tr.augh.mixup: Blends pairs of images and their classes (with CutMix, one of the two per batch).
tr.augh.cutmix: Pastes a patch of one image on another; the classes mix by area.
tr.augph.p: Chance of applying it to each image (0 to 1).
tr.augph.scale_min: Smallest share of the area (crop) or smallest zoom (below 1 shows more, with a black border).
tr.augph.fraction: Largest shift, as a share of the width and height.
tr.augph.brightness: Brightness change, up to this share.
tr.augph.contrast: Contrast change, up to this share.
tr.augph.saturation: Saturation change, up to this share.
tr.augph.hue: Hue shift, up to this share of the colour wheel.
tr.augph.alpha: Beta distribution parameter: larger mixes more.
tr.folds_runs: {k} trainings, one per fold; the result is their mean.
tr.ranking_help: Combinations ordered by the selection metric on validation.
tr.ranking_help_folds: Combinations ordered by the mean over the {k} folds (± standard deviation).
tr.viewing_best: Curves and results of the best training: {name}
tr.viewing_current: Curves of the training in progress: {name}
tr.p.close_mosaic: Mosaic off for the last epochs
md.intro: The best training runs saved as model versions, and public pretrained models. The current model is the one used next.
md.mapping_summary: {n} of {total} project classes linked to a model category
md.empty: No models yet. Save a finished run as a model or add a public model.
md.save_help: The best weights of this run become a new model version (m1, m2…). The first model of the project becomes the current one.
md.note_placeholder: E.g. first model with the night images
md.made_current: m{n} is now the current model.
md.edit_note_aria: Edit the note of model m{n}
md.delete_text: Its weights and exports are removed. The training run it came from stays in Training but, without the weights, it cannot be saved as a model again.
md.compare_help: Each column is a model; the best value of each row is highlighted.
md.export_help: ONNX runs without PyTorch (onnxruntime, OpenCV, TensorRT…). The onnx package is installed on the first export.
md.onnx_later: ONNX for detection models comes later
jobs.close: Close (finished activities stay in the history)
jobs.dismiss: Dismiss the failed activity (it stays in the history)
md.format_pt: PyTorch (.pt), the original output of the training
md.format_onnx_help: The ONNX file is made right after saving, in the training queue; you can also make it later.
md.saved_onnx: Saved as model m{n}; the ONNX export is queued.
ann.load_intro: For annotations you already have outside ActiveLabel (COCO, YOLO, CVAT, Pascal VOC, MOT… or a .zip). Nothing is saved before you see the report and confirm.
pre.form_intro: A saved model suggests labels for new images. Nothing a person made is changed, and suggestions only go into a training after review.
pre.model_missing_hint: Models marked unavailable were saved with an architecture this version no longer offers, so they cannot pre-annotate.
pre.threshold_cls: Below it the image stays without a label.
pre.threshold_det: Objects below it are left out.
pre.start_none: No image matches this choice. Pick another task or set of images.
pre.review_help: What comes back from CVAT or FiftyOne counts as reviewed. 'Accept as they are' keeps the labels and marks them reviewed.
pre.no_models: To pre-annotate, save a trained model or add a public model in Models.
pre.result_none_long: The model was never at least {v} sure in these images. Try a lower minimum confidence (models trained on few images give low scores).
pre.result_done: Pre-annotation done (images: {images}, labels: {objects}): review them below.
pre.accept_text_one: The labels of {n} image stay as the model made them and count as reviewed (they can go into a training).
pre.accept_text_other: The labels of {n} images stay as the model made them and count as reviewed (they can go into a training).
ann.to_review_one: {n} image with pre-annotations waits for review (Pre-annotate tab).
ann.to_review_other: {n} images with pre-annotations wait for review (Pre-annotate tab).
cur.select_hint: Tick images in the grid (or use the buttons beside) to exclude them from the set.
cur.select_hint_excluded: Tick images to restore them or delete them for good.
annotate.scope_more: Other choices appear when they apply: pre-annotated images, images selected in Curation and images with a problem found by the analysis.
tr.start_scratch_only: This model has no pretrained weights: it starts from scratch.
sync.compare_busy: A comparison with CVAT is already running.
ann.way_cvat_help: Sends the tasks to CVAT and brings the annotations back.
ann.way_fiftyone_help: Opens the images in FiftyOne to draw and review.
ann.way_files_help: For annotations you already have in files (COCO, YOLO, CVAT…).
ann.way_model_help: A model suggests the labels; you review them afterwards.
tr.hidden_classes_one: {n} class without images or predictions is hidden.
tr.hidden_classes_other: {n} classes without images or predictions are hidden.
md.public_intro: A model already trained by others (no training here) to pre-annotate the images. Choose the model and say which of its categories becomes each class of the project.
md.mapping_help: For each class of the project, the model's category that stands for it. Categories not chosen are ignored.
md.mapping_empty: Choose the category of at least one class.
md.mapping_duplicate: The category "{category}" is chosen for more than one class ({classes}). Each category can go to only one class.
md.public_license: torchvision code (BSD-3 licence); weights trained on COCO 2017. The weights are downloaded into the temporary folder of each pre-annotation and removed at the end.
md.public_none: There is no public model for this project type yet.
md.public_weights: Public weights, downloaded on each use
md.pub.coco_fasterrcnn_mobilenet_v3: Fastest; good to start, also on a computer without a GPU.
